from django.db.models.functions import Concat, Now


class ItemKind(models.TextChoices):
    TOOL = "tool", "Tool"
    TOY = "toy", "Toy"


class Item(models.Model):
    id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    first_name = models.CharField(max_length=40)
    last_name = models.CharField(max_length=40)
    full_name = models.GeneratedField(expression=Concat("first_name", Value(" "), "last_name"), output_field=models.CharField(max_length=81), db_persist=True)
    quantity = models.IntegerField(default=1)
    total_cents = models.GeneratedField(expression=F("quantity") * 100, output_field=models.IntegerField(), db_persist=False)
    tags = ArrayField(models.CharField(max_length=20), default=list)

    kinds = ArrayField(models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=ItemKind.choices), default=list)
    attributes = HStoreField(default=dict)
    stock_range = IntegerRangeField(null=True, blank=True)
    big_range = BigIntegerRangeField(null=True, blank=True)
    price_range = DecimalRangeField(null=True, blank=True)
    available = DateRangeField(null=True, blank=True)
    valid_during = DateTimeRangeField(null=True, blank=True)
    last_ip = models.GenericIPAddressField(null=True, blank=True)
    legacy_ip = models.GenericIPAddressField(unique=True, null=True, blank=True)
    shelf_life = models.DurationField(null=True, blank=True)
    source_path = models.CharField(max_length=100, null=True, blank=True)
    manual = models.CharField(max_length=100, null=True, blank=True)
    photo = models.CharField(max_length=100, null=True, blank=True)
    small_count = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    tiny_count = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(db_default=True)
    stocked_at = models.DateTimeField(db_default=Now())
    priority = models.IntegerField(db_default=5)
    note = models.CharField(max_length=20, db_default="none")

        db_table = "shop_item"

class Shipment(models.Model):
    id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    object_id = models.IntegerField()
    item = models.ForeignKey("Item", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="shipments")
    other = models.ForeignKey("Item", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="other_shipments")
    content_type = models.ForeignKey("ContentType", on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey("Account", on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "shop_shipment"

class Assignment(models.Model):

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey("item", "account")
